Legal.title: Terms and privacy
Legal.intro: Sawwiq showcases the work of social media agencies in Jordan. This page summarises how we use data and what each side is responsible for. The full legal version is under review.
Legal.s1: You don't need an account. We use an anonymous cookie to remember your likes, saves and follows on your device, and to count views once a day. We don't sell your data or use third-party ads.
Legal.s2: When you message an agency, we share your name, number and message with that agency only, with your explicit consent. Messages are kept for 24 months, then deleted.
Legal.s3: You are responsible for the accuracy of your page and for having the right to publish the work you show. Sponsored posts are always labelled "Sponsored". We may hide content that breaks these rules or suspend accounts.
Legal.s4: Under Jordan's Personal Data Protection Law No. 24 of 2023 you can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent. Write to privacy@sawwiq.jo.
Legal.s5: The platform is currently free for everyone. Any paid plans will be announced in advance and never charged without agreement.

Hire.how1: Browse real agency work and filter by service, city and budget.
Hire.how2: Compare starting prices, verification and followers, and save what you like.
Hire.how3: Contact them directly on WhatsApp or send a message. No commission, no sign-up.
Hire.priceBody: Based on starting prices published by {count} agencies on Sawwiq, monthly packages start from {min} JOD and go up to {max} JOD, with a median of {median} JOD. The final price depends on the number of posts, platforms and paid ads.
Hire.priceNone: Agencies haven't published prices for this service yet. Contact them directly for a quote.
Hire.faq1q: How do I choose the right {service} agency?
Hire.faq1a: Start with their past work in your industry, then compare the starting price and what it includes. Ask for measurable results and look for the verified badge.
Hire.faq2a: It means the Sawwiq team checked the agency's commercial registration. It is not a guarantee of work quality, so review their work and talk to them before agreeing.
Hire.faq3q: Do I pay Sawwiq a commission?
Hire.faq3a: No. Browsing and contacting agencies is completely free, and you agree terms with the agency directly.
Hire.faq4q: Can I work with an agency from another city?
Hire.faq4a: Yes. Most social media services are delivered remotely, though photo and video production is easier with an agency near you.
